title: v5.3.6 — Leaderboard Pages, Profile Fix & Login Polish
message: Leaderboard now has paginated pages (20 per page) with Google-style page numbers at the bottom. Bot names replaced with realistic player-style usernames. Profile popup: tier badge now has its own styled row with colored background, Achieve renamed to Achievements. Quick Setup scroll-locked so background doesn't move. Login: Google sign-in confirmation restored, email autocomplete for password managers, email confirmation preview before submitting, friendly error messages. Localhost known issue documented in About.
